t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I must pick which gnome or basket that seem to fetch me the most point and do not alternate just keep repeating the selection that gives the most point.

vb_textbox.text: You should try and test multiple colors to see which best brings out more mushrooms as well as harvesting more mushrooms. if one color you pick randomly fetches you the most mushrooms, you would have to stick to it for some time, as you go on the choices change as you select. make sure you do your best.
